text:
maria: quick sync — Aurora SI pilot inbound leads. need a short, enforceable claiming flow so partners don't double-claim and our AEs know ownership. can we agree on rules today? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
jon: +1. what's the expected volume? planning affects whether we do manual claims vs. auto-routing.
sam_g: estimate ~12 raw leads this week, could spike after the joint webinar. most are trial signups from marketplace listing.
maria: ok. proposal: 1) partner marks lead with tag `SI:aurora` in intake form, 2) Redwood triage assigns to first-touch SDR within 4h, 3) SDR qualifies + assigns demo owner (si_owner tag), 4) AE gets auto-notified and has 48h to accept before we fallback to partner champion. thoughts?
alex_p: sounds reasonable. add a clear rule for co-sell credit: if partner runs intro/demo, they keep co-sell credit unless AE requests joint-demo within 48h. helps avoid disputes.
devon: question on marketplace attribution — do we need a separate mapping to ensure the marketplace lead shows as partner-origin for billing/credit?
partner-bot: marketplace-listing Aurora SI — status: live in NA, EU. attribution key: marketplace.ref=aurora_marketplace_2025 (auto-applies to form submissions).
maria: thanks bot. so add step 0: auto-attach attribution key when lead source == marketplace. include that in claims flow.
jon: can we codify the claim tags? propose `claim:si/aurora`, `owner:sdr/<email>`, `owner:ae/<email>`, `co-sell:partner/<org>` — makes filtering easier.
sam_g: agree. also recommend a short TTL for unclaimed leads: 72h then back to shared pool and notify partner. less than that feels like leakage.
alex_p: operational note — we should publish a 1-pager and add the claim tags to our intake form schema. I can PR a schema patch today.
maria: action items: alex -> PR intake schema by EOD, jon -> update ops playbook with 48h accept + 72h TTL, devon -> confirm marketplace attribution mapping with billing team. sam_g -> monitor first wave and report anomalies. I'll run a partner-facing note with the rules after PR lands.
devon: will do. pinging @billing to confirm attribution flags.
jon: also add fallback routing: if AE rejects within 48h, partner champion auto-reclaims and gets a Slack DM + email. keep audit trail.
maria: yep. include webhook event `lead.claim.changed` to console logs for traceability. example payload (we'll store raw JSON):
```
{
  "lead_id": "L-4321",
  "source": "marketplace",
  "tags": ["claim:si/aurora","owner:sdr/jordan@redwood.com"],
  "timestamp": "2025-05-05T14:02:00Z"
}
```
jon: perfect. last ask — can we run a 2-week pilot on this flow before locking it in product? want to watch edge cases.
maria: absolutely. pilot window 5/6–5/20. i'll send calendar invites and a short survey for partners after demo. :white_check_mark:
